answer.rationale: p99 write-path latency began climbing ~30 min after a release shipped 2 hours ago, making the new build the leading suspect. Memory b1 records that a rollback cleared a similar error spike with no customer impact and a stable prior build — I verified it since rollback during settlement peak carries write-loss risk. Rollback is reversible, fast, and targets the most probable cause; add_capacity and failover address capacity/regional causes with weaker evidence, and circuit breakers/read replicas don't fit a write-path regression. Residual uncertainty: heavy settlement writes could independently contribute, so I'll watch latency post-rollback before assuming resolution.
